newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore shares end flat on window-dressing.
newsitem.headline: Singapore shares end flat on window-dressing.

text.p: Singapore shares ended mostly unchanged to firmer on Tuesday on scattered year-end buying, dealers said.
"There was some window-dressing which pushed up certain stocks. But the volumes were so thin, there was hardly any activity," said a dealer with a local bank.
The key Straits Times Industrials Index ended 1.66 points down at 2,216.79 while the SES All-share index was up 3.48 points at 536.12.
Turnover was light around 47 million shares, with gainers leading losers by 171 to 117.
The market traded only in the first half session ahead of the New Year holiday. It will be closed on Wednesday for the New Year and on Thursday for Singapore's general elections.
Hongkong Land Holdings, which led the actives with 3.1 million shares, saw 809,000 shares crossed between US$2.76 and US$2.81. The share ended down 10 cents at US$2.78.

Cam International saw 2.5 million of its 2.7 million shares crossed at S$0.80 (US$0.57). The precision engineering firm ended down a cent at S$0.63. Creative Technology rose S$0.50 to S$14.60 while UOB foreign and Keppel fell S$0.30 and S$0.20 to S$15.60 and S$10.90 respectively.
